statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tuesday’s U.S. session closed broadly lower with oil and Treasury yields still pressuring risk assets, but semiconductors finished slightly firmer and direct NQ evidence of repeated failed retracements or no-pullback continuation remains unavailable. Tail is low while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH after the cash close; the next major conditional checkpoints are Wednesday’s 12:30 UTC data/cash-open sequence and the 18:00 UTC FOMC decision with the 18:30 press conference.
headline: Post-close Tail returns to low while oil, yields and the FOMC keep Stress extreme
body: Reuters reported the Nasdaq Composite down 0.78%, the S&P 500 down 0.47% and the Dow down 0.82%, with the semiconductor index slightly positive. Brent settled at $108.75 and WTI at $105.83 as energy-supply disruptions persisted. High cross-asset Stress is not, by itself, evidence of a pathological NQ price path.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail ranged from 18% to 23%. It was low through most overnight hours, moved into WATCH through much of Tuesday morning, briefly eased around the U.S. open, then climbed back to WATCH as broad equity weakness, high oil and near-5% Treasury yields persisted into power hour.
outlookSummary: Post-close Tail is low despite extreme Stress because direct NQ mean-reversion-failure evidence remains unavailable and semiconductor performance conflicts with broader weakness. Wednesday’s 12:30 UTC Retail Sales/import-price releases, 13:30 UTC cash open, and the 18:00/18:30 UTC FOMC sequence are the principal conditional risk checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: The cash session closed with Nasdaq down 0.78%, broad sector weakness, a near-5% 10-year backdrop and Brent above $108, while semiconductors ended slightly higher. Without direct evidence of repeated failed NQ retracements or no-pullback continuation, Tail is low and Stress remains extreme.
drivers: Broad U.S. equity weakness into the close
Brent settled above $108 and Treasury yields remain elevated

news.title: Wall Street dips as oil spikes and benchmark Treasury yields breach 5%
Oil settles $3 higher on Yanbu disruption, Saudi cargo cancellations

forecast.analysis: In the first post-close hour, Tail stays low if futures rotate two-sided rather than extend Tuesday’s loss. Oil and rates keep Stress extreme, while renewed one-way NQ continuation with shallow pullbacks would invalidate the low-Tail path.
drivers: Post-close two-sided rotation is the baseline
Oil and rates remain high-Stress background
Shallow-pullback continuation would invalidate low Tail

forecast.analysis: Early evening Tail remains low if retracements remain available. A fresh energy or rates shock affects Tail materially only if NQ responds with repeated extension or sustained extreme holding.
drivers: Fresh macro shocks require NQ follow-through

forecast.analysis: Later evening risk remains dominated by Stress rather than Tail under balanced trade. A clean break that repeatedly rejects counter-moves would be the principal path-based escalation signal.
At the Asia-session handoff, low Tail assumes two-sided price discovery. Persistent continuation across the transition with little retracement would raise path risk independently of event headlines.
drivers: Continuation across the handoff with little retracement

forecast.analysis: Early Asia remains low-Tail if directional efficiency fades. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks, especially with aligned rates and oil, would be the main conditional escalation route.
Overnight Tail stays low while mean reversion remains available. Elevated oil or yields alone sustain Stress but do not justify a Tail block without persistent NQ structure.
drivers: Oil and yields primarily sustain Stress

forecast.analysis: The quieter overnight hour remains low-Tail under ordinary two-sided flow. Session-extreme holding with repeated failed retracements would be the contrary structure to monitor.
Ahead of Europe, Tail remains low unless cross-asset pressure reconnects with persistent NQ extension. Mixed evidence favors Stress over Tail in the absence of a one-way price path.
drivers: Persistent NQ extension is required for escalation

forecast.analysis: Europe’s opening transition can lift volatility without creating pathological Tail. Tail edges up only if early directional moves stop retracing and cross-assets reinforce the same direction.
drivers: Directional moves must stop retracing to raise Tail

forecast.analysis: As European liquidity deepens, Tail remains low if opening moves retrace. Sustained yield or oil pressure becomes more consequential only alongside repeated NQ extension.
drivers: Cross-asset pressure needs repeated NQ extension

forecast.analysis: Late European morning keeps Tail low under mixed structure. A persistent pre-U.S. trend with shallow pullbacks would be the main condition for moving into WATCH before the data window.
drivers: Shallow pullbacks would move Tail toward WATCH

forecast.analysis: Early U.S. premarket conditions remain below WATCH if retracements continue. Sensitivity to rates and oil rises, but the scheduled data are still several hours away and are not Tail evidence by themselves.
drivers: Rates and oil remain background Stress
Scheduled releases are not path evidence

forecast.analysis: Premarket Tail remains low unless a directional gap begins extending without meaningful pullback. Otherwise pressure from oil, yields and Fed expectations is reflected mainly in Stress.
drivers: Oil, yields and Fed expectations mainly raise Stress

forecast.analysis: Two hours before the major data window, Tail is still low under ordinary pre-event balance. Escalation would require an abnormal gap or persistent extension before the release.
drivers: Abnormal gap or persistent extension before 12:30 UTC

forecast.analysis: The hour before Retail Sales and import-price data carries rising Stress but still low Tail absent observed pre-release one-way structure. The release is a checkpoint, not a forecast of its outcome.
drivers: 12:30 UTC Retail Sales and import-price checkpoint

forecast.analysis: Retail Sales and import/export prices arrive at 12:30 UTC. Tail moves into WATCH conditionally because a large surprise could reshape the opening path, but escalation still depends on post-release persistence, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements.
drivers: 12:30 UTC Import and Export Price Indexes

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash open at 13:30 UTC follows the morning data. Tail peaks at the top of WATCH if the opening auction confirms persistent extension; meaningful retracement or mixed breadth would argue against a higher band.

In the first full cash-session hour, WATCH persists only if the opening move holds near extremes and pullbacks repeatedly fail. Two-sided trade would allow Tail to recede even if volatility stays high.
Midday Tail eases toward the bottom of WATCH if the opening impulse loses efficiency. Residual Stress stays high because the FOMC is still ahead and energy/rates remain sensitive.

Early afternoon Tail stays at WATCH only conditionally as the market positions ahead of the Fed. A stable two-sided range would argue for lower Tail; an aligned directional drift with shallow pullbacks would keep path risk elevated.
drivers: Aligned drift with shallow pullbacks would sustain WATCH

forecast.analysis: The hour before the FOMC decision moves Tail higher within WATCH. The known 18:00 UTC statement and 18:30 press conference create a multi-stage checkpoint, but no future outcome or directional reaction is assumed.
drivers: Multi-stage repricing risk without assumed direction

forecast.analysis: The FOMC decision at 18:00 UTC and press conference at 18:30 create the day’s highest conditional Stress. Tail remains capped at WATCH before observed path evidence; persistent extension through the statement/Q&A and cross-asset confirmation would be the escalation condition.
drivers: Persistent extension through statement and Q&A is the Tail checkpoint

forecast.analysis: The first post-FOMC hour carries delayed second-leg risk. Tail remains at the top of WATCH conditionally; a higher band would require observed failed retracements, session-extreme holding or a reinforced rates/equity move after the press conference.
drivers: Failed retracements after the press conference
Rates/equity reinforcement would be an amplifier

forecastDetail.comment: Cash-close weakness keeps Stress extreme, but firmer semiconductors and missing direct NQ mean-reversion-failure evidence keep Tail low.
Post-close Tail stays low if two-sided rotation returns; shallow-pullback continuation would invalidate that path.
Early evening remains low-Tail while retracements are available; fresh shocks require persistent NQ follow-through.
Balanced trade keeps Tail low; repeated rejection of counter-moves would be the main escalation signal.
Asia handoff remains low-Tail under two-sided discovery; continuation without retracement would raise path risk.
Early Asia remains low-Tail if directional efficiency fades; failed-pullback extension would be the key contrary signal.
